name: web-hype-burger-site-in-black-yellow-pink-and-blue-with-stickers
title: Angled multi-colour burger site: black and blue heroes with 'Mind Blowing Bites', sticker badges, pink and yellow cards and pastel menu tiles
whatItIs: A collage of the same site tilted across the frame: a black hero with a giant white 'Mind Blowing Bites' and a burger, a smiley-eyes sticker and thumbs-up badge, a pink card with a polaroid of two smiling people with sticker badges, yellow feature rows with arrow buttons, a blue 'Feel the Hype' banner, menu grids in pastel violet, blue, pink and yellow with burgers and dark Order Now buttons, and a black footer.
whatItMeans: Loud and playful; sticker badges and multi-colour tiles feel like street food culture.
techniques: Use sticker badges like eyes and a thumbs-up.
Set giant bold white headlines on black or blue.

vocabulary.definition: A scalloped circle with an icon.
A pastel card with a dish and price tag.
Layouts rotated and cropped in one image.
A photo in a white-bordered frame.
